newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound falls marginally in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound falls marginally in quiet market.

text.p: A banker said the Egyptian pound fell fractionally against the dollar in the private-sector market on Sunday.
Other bankers said they did not deal in the foreign exchange market on Sunday, the weekend in most major world centres.
The dollar was quoted at 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3980 pounds offered, the banker said.

On Thursday, a survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3951 pounds bid and 3.3966 pound offered. These averages compare to 3.3953 pounds bid and 3.3970 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.392144 buy and 3.398346 sell.
